description: React component implementing a filter bar with toggle pills for filtering items based on 'hasIssues', 'hasLicense', and 'archived' statuses. It includes a child component 'Pill' for individual toggle buttons.

classes.name: FilterValues
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the shape of filter state with boolean flags for 'hasIssues', 'hasLicense', and 'archived'.

methods.name: Filters
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering a set of toggle pills for filtering, managing state toggling through 'toggle' function.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Function to invert the boolean value of a specified filter key and trigger the 'onChange' callback.

methods.name: Pill
methods.description: Child React functional component representing an individual toggle button with styling based on active state.

calls: clsx('px-3 py-1 rounded-full border text-sm transition-colors', active ? 'bg-primary-600/20 text-primary-300 border-primary-700' : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800')
